figurative_meaning_en: To take responsibility or undertake a duty
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্পটি হাতে নেওয়ার পর কাজ শুরু হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He has taken the family responsibility in hand.
The project started after taking it in hand.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on personal accountability in Bengali society.
